plan.head: b4bcc4523fc4ca6799c0a790f6b806036ccd438a
plan.source: Canonical private frame/value-plan implementation. Go base9c and LLGo base5ab Go/module sources verified equal to8c. Head build b4bcc452; Go1.27.3; LLGo5860fb6f O3/fullLTO/defaultGC; Wasmtime48.0.1 pinned retained independent provider.
plan.scope: Fixed 10 blocks per compiler/payload, symmetric AA for every role, 4Stores16clients20interleaved512request batches plusflush. Full bodies/status/headers/trailers/CRC and guestjoin. Complete driver CPU/instructions are not pure guest/exclusive component costs. Startup/load/compile/instantiate/first/warmups/cleanup separate. Managed allocation scopes cannot rank total Rust/C/JIT allocation. No owned build/test/profile/analysis/edit/pruning during timed cohorts. External load snapshots retained. Paired block geometric ratios with20000 bootstrap95 intervals, AA full interval mustfit[.975,1.025]. Preserve failures; no extension/pooling or portfolio acceptance.
